directory_title: All-in-One India Shopping & Consumer Services Directory
scope: Verified core national, major regional and specialized consumer platforms, plus clearly marked discontinued services.
verification_note: Current status and India availability were checked against official platform pages and recent web evidence. Service availability can vary by PIN code/city. Regional platforms are included only where a current web/app footprint was found.
important_current_status_notes: Amazon Now is active and expanding in India.
Flipkart Minutes is active and expanding in India.
Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes and BigBasket are active quick-commerce platforms.
Dunzo consumer operations are discontinued; its app/website went offline in January 2025.
JioMart Express is treated as a discontinued/replaced standalone quick-commerce service rather than a current independent platform.
